name: Opendoor Technologies, Inc.
blurb: Opendoor is an iBuyer — a company that purchases homes algorithmically for rapid resale, aiming to bring liquidity and simplicity to the residential real-estate transaction. It went public via SPAC in 2020 at elevated valuations, then suffered a protracted decline as rising interest rates crushed housing-market transaction volumes and compressed the margins on its home-flipping model.
recent: In mid-2025, Opendoor became a retail-driven meme stock, rising roughly 237% from July lows as co-founders Keith Rabois (who became chairman) and Eric Wu rejoined the board, injecting approximately $40 million of personal capital. Kaz Nejatian, formerly COO of Shopify, was named CEO in September 2025 and described a pivot to an AI- and software-driven platform under the 'Opendoor 2.0' framing. Q3 2025 revenue fell 34% year-over-year with a net loss of $90 million. The stock subsequently retreated sharply after earnings disappointed and the meme-momentum dissipated.
